# awacino_devices (Data Source)

The company's Beam-in and Beam-out devices, optionally filtered. Key section **Connections** (Read).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_devices" "servers" {
  role = "beamin"
  kind = "unattended"
}

output "servers_in_lobby" {
  value = [for d in data.awacino_devices.servers.devices : d.name if d.status == "lobby"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) The external_id given at enrolment.
- `kind` (String) `app` or `unattended`.
- `member_id` (String) Devices registered by this member.
- `name` (String) Exact device name (case-insensitive).
- `role` (String) `beamin` or `beamout`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `lobby`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `external_id` (String) The external_id given at enrolment.
- `first_seen` (String) First seen.
- `id` (String) Device id.
- `kind` (String) `app` or `unattended`.
- `last_seen` (String) Last seen (Beam-in devices).
- `member_id` (String) The member who registered it.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `platform` (String) `macos`, `windows`, `linux`, `ios`, `android`, `docker`, ...
- `role` (String) `beamin` (can be reached) or `beamout` (connects out).
- `status` (String) `active` or `lobby`.
